run_ttyplay_playback: run a ttyrec recording file with default speed and timing using the ttyplay CLI tool
run_ttyplay_speed_control: run a ttyrec recording at 2x speed using the -s flag to set playback speed multiplier
run_ttyplay_no_wait: run a ttyrec recording with no wait between frames using the -n flag for instant playback
run_ttyplay_peek_mode: run a ttyrec recording in peek mode using the -p flag to tail new data like tail -f
run_ttyplay_print_inputs: run a ttyrec recording with the -i flag to print input events alongside output frames
